---
title: "Gravisim — ground-based microgravity research"
subtitle: "Space and microgravity biology"
status: "Patent filed"
---

Spaceflight access is necessarily limited. Gravisim provides a ground-based platform for controlled,
repeatable microgravity studies with cells and bioengineered tissues, allowing observations from
flight to be investigated experimentally in the laboratory.

## Research programme

The platform supports studies of cellular adaptation, tissue function and recovery under simulated
microgravity. We use it alongside our spaceflight programme to carry mission-derived
questions with experiments that can be repeated and extended on the ground.

A patent has been filed for the Gravisim microgravity system. Technical construction, validation and
performance details are therefore not disclosed on this website.
